about_the_game:
TERMITE is an exciting turn-based strategy game that puts you in command of an army of termites ready for battle. Face your friends or players from all over the world in intense matches where creativity, tactics and resourcefulness are the key to victory.

With a wide variety of unique weapons and tools, TERMITE allows you to destroy the terrain, carry out precise attacks and surprise your opponents with unpredictable strategies. From explosive launchers to special abilities, each match is a unique experience in which no move is final until the last moment.

Destructible terrain adds an extra level of strategy, forcing players to constantly adapt to a changing battlefield. In addition, the design of scenarios and characters provides a fun and casual touch, which will make you enjoy every game also on the visual level.

Main features:

  • Turn-based strategy: Every decision counts, so think carefully before you act.

  • Destructible terrain: Modify the map with your attacks to gain tactical advantage.

  • Unique weapons: Explore a creative arsenal to defeat your rivals in original ways.

  • Online multiplayer: Compete against players from all over the world or challenge your friends.

  • Hilarious design: Attractive aesthetics and animations that will make you enjoy every battle.

TERMITE is perfect for fans of strategy games who are looking for fast, entertaining and eventful battles. Get ready to lead your termite army and prove your skills in every battle!
